description: Multilingual TTS (31 languages) that clones a voice from a reference clip, with long-form stability. Type [pause 1.5s] for an explicit pause; Pinyin and IPA are read as pronunciation. Set the language for the best results. Two models: 8B (24 kHz) and the smaller Local 4B (48 kHz stereo). Experimental.

settings.label: Model
optionLabels: MOSS-TTS Local v1.5 (4B, 14 GB, 48 kHz stereo)
settings.description: The Local model is smaller and faster. The 8B model is the one upstream recommends for production.

settings.label: Language
settings.description: Set it whenever you know the language: v1.5 is clearly better with the tag than without.

settings.label: Temperature
settings.description: Sampling temperature of the audio tokens. Upstream's value is high on purpose.

settings.label: Stop temperature
settings.description: How loosely the model decides when to stop. Upstream's 8B default of 1.5 can end a take in the middle of the text.
